head: 659188f3f819adf57333808a121c2aca057fa628
reason: UI surface changed and a dev server + backend are reachable, but the feature cannot be exercised in this environment: features:projectChargeback is disabled/absent on the backend (/api/v1/config) so the chargeback UI does not render, and the project budget flow is Keycloak-gated (/api/v1/projects -> 401) with no editor credentials available. AC10 (focus-trap/z-index of the nested CostCenterFormPopup) specifically requires a real browser reaching this flow.
remediation: Provide a reachable app URL where (1) features:projectChargeback is enabled server-side, (2) an authenticated session/credentials with editor rights on a project are available, and (3) a separate non-editor account for the read-only case. Then this verification can install Playwright and exercise the flow.
